673d8bd62405.text: datasette-leaflet 0.3. Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy. datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. It now sets the referrer policy on the tile requests themselves to strict-origin-when-cross-origin , passing the host but not the full path to the page. Tags: leaflet , datasette , openstreetmap

debates.title: Are benchmarks keeping up with AI capabilities?
debates.summary: Ethan Mollick's SatBench analysis shows 63% of 173 major benchmarks are now saturated, with new benchmarks saturating faster. This raises urgent questions about how to measure progress when standard tests become obsolete almost as quickly as they're published.

positions.stance: Finds that 63% of benchmarks cited by labs since 2023 are now saturated, and saturation of new benchmarks is accelerating.
Flags FrontierML, a new benchmark measuring AI systems' ability to sub-contract and spend money to improve themselves.

debates.title: Model pricing wars: what's the real value?
debates.summary: Three major model releases in one week — Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Claude Fable 5.2, and Meta's Muse Ember — have sparked confusion over pricing structures and value. Gemini's scheduled price doubling, Fable's token hunger despite a price cut, and Muse Ember's 80x cheaper tier create a messy comparison landscape.

debates.title: AI agents transforming coding, research, and education
debates.summary: Multiple practitioners report that AI agents have fundamentally changed professional workflows in under a year. Coding, research, and student projects are moving an order of magnitude faster, with agent swarms autonomously conducting multi-step research and building complete applications.

positions.stance: States the coding profession transformed in less than a year; agent swarms are relentless at research, and student projects are 10x further along than team projects from three years ago.
Builds multiple Datasette plugins (datasette-maplibre, datasette-apps, datasette-agent, llm-gemini) largely through prompting Claude Fable 5.2.
Reports ArtCraft has cloned 17 open-source versions of popular software tools including Photoshop and Acrobat, aiming to rebuild entire software categories.

debates.title: Nvidia leadership crisis threatens open AI ecosystem
debates.summary: Jensen Huang's resignation after 33 years creates uncertainty for the open-model ecosystem that depended on Nvidia's strategic support. The company's commitment to open models was already a complex puzzle; losing its operator-in-chief raises questions about whether that support continues.

positions.stance: Reports Jensen Huang resigned after 33 years following board pressure linked to personal controversies; correlation with Chinese chip-smuggling investigations noted.
Argues the resignation is a major setback for US open-model development; Nvidia's support for open ecosystems was a tricky puzzle dependent on Jensen as operator.
